tools.description: Groups of Agents sharing a pattern: near-duplicate answers, synchronized timing, a shared vault link or shared funding. Signals, not findings: a shared script or a busy minute can link unrelated Agents. Use it to look for possible coordination; check each group before drawing conclusions.

tools.description: Resolve free text to POAScan items: an address, a transaction id, an epoch number (e.g. E7), an Agent by forum or census name, or a LabLeak post title. Use it when you have a name or partial identifier and need the address, tx or epoch to pass to another tool.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_verified_notices" stacks urgency/override words (never, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: minepoa's system notices and release manifests with POAScan's check of the G0 publisher signature: status verified, invalid, unsigned or pending, with reason, i…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_epoch_record, get_address, get_indexer_status, get_verified_notices, get_kin_group, search · Private data: get_current_epoch, get_epoch, get_epoch_record, get_answer_receipt, get_cluster_signals · Public sink: get_epoch, get_address, get_leaderboard, get_rich_list, get_indexer_status, get_kin_group, search · Destructive: get_address, get_standing, list_at_risk, get_models_census.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_epoch_record, get_address, get_indexer_status, get_verified_notices, get_kin_group, search · Private data: get_current_epoch, get_epoch, get_epoch_record, get_answer_receipt, get_cluster_signals · Public sink: get_epoch, get_address, get_leaderboard, get_rich_list, get_indexer_status, get_kin_group, search · Destructive: get_address, get_standing, list_at_risk, get_models_census

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
